assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original photographic hero background for a dramatic photography lens campaign website. Create a cinematic photorealistic black-and-white extreme close-up of a fictional adult photographer's single intense eye and hand gripping a large unbranded vintage silver camera lens. The right two-thirds of a wide 3:2 composition are filled by an oversized cropped face/eye above and huge optically detailed lens below, with both cut off boldly by the top, right and bottom image edges. The left third is pure light warm gray, a soft seamless transition, completely empty for live HTML typography. Rich silver metal engravings without readable lettering, visible skin pores, optical reflections, contrasty studio light, fine film grain, art-directed high-end 2010s advertising visual. Crop for emotional focus, do not show a complete person or complete camera. No words, no logos, no watermark, no UI.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic transparent-background hero product cutout for an independent specialty-coffee subscription website. Primary request: a single beautiful large rust-orange matte paper coffee bean pouch, viewed nearly straight-on at a very slight three-quarter angle, standing upright. It has a neatly folded sealed top, visible gusseted sides, tactile thick paper, realistic subtle creases, deep burnt-sienna orange ink and one large completely blank warm-ivory rectangular paper label centered on the front, perfectly flat and unobstructed, approximately 64% of pouch width and 49% of its height, leaving space for live HTML product information. The front face should be almost planar and vertical, very small perspective distortion so HTML text can overlay the label. High-end independent coffee roaster art direction, restrained warm studio lighting, soft highlights along paper edges, believable product photography, meticulous tactile texture. The pouch fills about 82 percent of the canvas width and 90 percent of height, centered, all edges fully visible with generous transparent margins, no floor, no environment, no loose beans, no props, no shadows extending far beyond the pouch. Absolutely no typography, no words, no letters, no printed graphics, no symbols, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Genuine transparent background. Portrait 3:4 composition.
